label: Cross-asset relative momentum
desc: The same ranking across every asset class, group-neutral.
rule: five formation windows · rank within class · long/short
config:
xs_momentum_cross_asset:
  asset_classes:
  - crypto
  - futures
  - fx
  universe_filters:
  - type: PrimaryOnly
  - type: ListingFilter
  - type: HistoryFilter
    params:
      min_days: 252
  - type: DataIntegrityFilter
  - type: LiquidityFilter
    params:
      min_volume: 100
      lookback: 63
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Identity
  signals:
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 1.0
    params:
      vol_estimator:
        type: EWMA2
        params:
          span: 32
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 252
          skip: 0
      ranker:
        type: GroupNeutralRank
        params:
          inner:
            type: PercentileRank
            params:
              min_names: 5
          min_group_size: 5
      position_function:
        type: QuantilePortfolio
        params:
          long_pct: 0.25
          short_pct: 0.25
          weighting: equal
          dollar_neutral: true
      risk_weighting:
        type: InverseVol
        params:
          target_vol: 0.15
          floor: 0.08
  asset_allocator:
    type: Identity
  model_gearing:
    type: XSVolTarget
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_lookback: 63
      leverage_cap: 3.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 3.0
  group_level: asset_class
  rebalance: daily
  position_smoothing: 10
